quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.lead: Quotes for clients: drafts, sent quotes and client replies. A quote gets its number when it is sent.
quotes.createDenied: You are not allowed to create quotes

empty.title: No quotes yet
empty.description: Create the first quote for a client: lines, discounts and totals, then send it.

submit.description: Only drafts are sent: each gets a number and can no longer be changed. Quotes in other statuses stay as they are, the report lists them with the reason.
submit.denied: You are not allowed to send quotes
submit.notAllowed: Only a draft can be sent

cancel.description: The quotes become void but stay in the list. One reason for all, it shows in the history of each. Drafts are not cancelled but deleted.
cancel.denied: You are not allowed to cancel quotes
cancel.notAllowed: Only a sent quote can be cancelled: a draft is deleted, a cancelled one is already cancelled

delete.description: Only drafts without a number are deleted, for good. A sent quote is not deleted but cancelled: such quotes stay, the report lists them with the reason.

quote.title: Quote

submit.title: Send the quote?
submit.description: The quote gets a number and can no longer be changed. Mistakes are fixed by cancelling it and creating a corrected copy.

decline.title: Did the client decline the quote?
decline.description: The quote becomes declined. You can add the reason to know it later.

quote.editDenied: You are not allowed to edit quotes

locked.submitted: A sent quote cannot be changed: cancel it and create a corrected copy
locked.cancelled: A cancelled quote cannot be changed: create a corrected copy

delete.denied: You are not allowed to delete quotes
delete.title: Delete the draft?
delete.description: The draft is deleted for good together with its lines. It has no number yet, so numbering does not change.
delete.descriptionAmended: The draft is deleted for good together with its lines. The cancelled quote it was made from can be corrected again.

locked.submitted: A sent quote is not deleted: cancel it
locked.cancelled: A cancelled quote is not deleted: it stays in the history

quote.linesInvalid: The quote lines could not be shown

form.validUntilBefore: Not earlier than the quote date
